name: n019_resdur_grid
purpose: Non-duplicate two-axis screen around the first complete nine-metric candidate. Test whether a higher rhythm extrapolation can recover W-NT L while keeping WER under control, and whether residual0.75 with the same higher rhythm improves the trade-off.

storage.public_home: not used for disposable WAV/VPC output because d10 /public/home reports zero bytes free

stop_conditions: input row count or hash mismatch
decision_rule: Do not promote from this screen alone. A combination must improve W-NT L relative to 41.801279 without pushing WER above 8.5, then must receive a matching LS360 E-VPC S evaluation before any formal replacement.
decision: Rejected the tested neighborhood. res0.5/dur0.6 does not improve W-NT L; res0.5/dur0.65 reaches W-NT L 42.263% but raises WER to 9.058%; res0.75/dur0.6 lowers W-NT L to 41.383%. The residual0.5+duration0.5 candidate remains the best balance.
